query: add keyboard shortcuts and a command bar to the existing stock adjustments page without changing its navigation or theme

missing: brand: no brand assets, guideline, or character description available

required.reason: numbers, tables or charts are the content

recommended.reason: few states; still handle failed media

core.title: Toolbar / command bar with selection-driven commands
core.guidance: Primary commands as labelled buttons, overflow into a menu, disabled (not hidden) when no selection, keyboard accelerators shown in tooltips, and the count of selected items visible near the commands.
core.use_when: Workbenches and tables: commands apply to the current selection, live in a persistent bar, and are mirrored by context menus and shortcuts.
core.avoid_when: Consumer or single-task screens; touch-first products.

implementation.winui: CommandBar with AppBarButton + KeyboardAccelerator; IsEnabled bound to selection.

core.title: No decorative imagery
core.guidance: Remove stock photos, abstract blobs, and hero illustrations from working screens; empty states may use a small, meaningful illustration or none. Identity comes from type, colour, and structure.
core.use_when: Operational products: imagery only where it is data (avatars, product thumbnails, charts).
core.avoid_when: Brand or content products where imagery is the content.

core.title: Table-first working screen
core.guidance: Table fills the viewport height with internal scrolling and sticky header, row density selectable, column widths persisted, filters as a row of chips/fields above the table (not a hidden drawer), bulk actions appear in the toolbar on selection. Numeric columns right-aligned with tabular figures. Virtualise beyond a few hundred rows.
core.use_when: The record set is the product (orders, transactions, tickets, inventory): users filter, sort, select, and bulk-act. Screen = toolbar + filters + table + optional side panel.
core.avoid_when: Phone widths (switch to list rows), fewer than ~20 rows, or when each record needs rich media.

implementation.winui: DataGrid from CommunityToolkit or a virtualised ListView with a header; enable IsItemClickEnabled and keyboard sorting.

core.selected_for: required coverage: tabular figures and numeric alignment

guardrails.title: Desktop: keyboard is a first-class input
guardrails.guidance: Document shortcuts in menus and tooltips; F2 edits, Delete deletes with undo, Ctrl+F finds, F6 cycles panes; grids use arrow keys and Ctrl/Shift selection; every dialog has a default and cancel button; access keys shown on Alt (Windows).
guardrails.use_when: Every desktop screen: shortcuts for frequent commands, access keys for menus, Tab/arrow semantics in lists, trees, grids, and toolbars, Enter/Escape in dialogs.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never assign shortcuts that collide with platform or assistive-tech shortcuts; never make Tab stop on every cell of a grid.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: visible focus, keyboard navigation and focus order

guardrails.title: Hover reveals need a non-hover path
guardrails.guidance: Hover-revealed content must also appear on focus and be reachable by touch (persistent affordance, long-press, or an explicit menu). Tooltips: dismissible, hoverable, persistent (WCAG 1.4.13). Never put essential actions only in hover.
guardrails.use_when: Row actions that appear on hover, tooltips, hover cards, mega menus.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never rely on hover alone; touch and keyboard users never hover.

guardrails.title: Desktop: persist layout and selection state
guardrails.guidance: Restore the workspace on launch (per user, per view), offer 'reset layout', keep undo history per document, and never lose selection on data refresh (re-select by key).
guardrails.use_when: Workbenches used daily: column widths/order, sort, filters, pane sizes, last selected record, open tabs.
guardrails.avoid_when: Do not persist transient errors or half-typed forms without telling the user.
